title: The Emotional Hazards of Being Considerate

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fun day out, I ask Mejiro Palmer if there's anywhere else she'd like to go before we head back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about we switch things up today and go somewhere you wanna go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're always busy, so I think a little break would do you some good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's how we end up strolling around town, but we don't get far before…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gasp! They opened up a new golf shop here! Wooow, that driver looks like it can really let 'em fly!
choice_data_list: Want to go in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's fine. I can check it out another time. We're in the middle of a walk right now, after all!
choice_data_list: (Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Usually, she'd jump on the offer and fly right into the shop, but something feels off about her today. Her weird behavior continues too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Which movie do I wanna watch? Honestly, the whole line-up looks super interesting, so whichever one you pick!
choice_data_list: Then how about we watch the featured film of the month?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's see… Oh, that'll be Brain-Bending Art Labyrinths ! Always nice to try something new!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: W-whoaaa… U-ummm…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They weren't kidding about the "brain-bending" part. Most of the movie went over my head. It was probably meant for art buffs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whew! What a flick! It was just so… So fancy!
choice_data_list: "Fancy" is one way to put it.
"Fancy" is one way to put it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: For sure! The visuals sure packed a punch! Stuff always leaves so much bigger an impact when it's blown up on the silver screen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is something bothering me? Hm… Now that you mention it…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've been getting a lot of sliced shots during golf lately, but that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about you? Anything weighing you down recently? I'd be happy to lend you an ear, whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every time I try to ask her what's wrong, she dodges the question and turns it back to me. Eventually, we wrap up our day out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Welp! Here we are at my dorm. Today flew by, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the fun day! Did you enjoy it too?
choice_data_list: I did, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? Looks like something's troubling you big time. Well, come on, then! I'm here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm all ears to whatever you might be worrying about!
choice_data_list: Did you really have fun today?
Did you really have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Of course, I did! Nothing makes me happier than seeing you enjoying yourself!
choice_data_list: It's the same for me.
It's the same for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Um… I don't get what you're trying to say.
choice_data_list: Did you really enjoy yourself?
Did you really enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yep, sure did! Or I guess, I feel more relieved than anything 'cause I didn't cause you any trouble!
choice_data_list: What? You never cause me any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, but like, I do! And I did! Remember the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You were planning to take care of some work, but you dropped everything just to help me sell all that milk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That wasn't the only time, either. You're always putting my wants and needs ahead of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm happy and grateful that you've always got my back, for real! But like…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't want you to keep prioritizing me if it means neglecting your own wants and needs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So… yeah! That's why I decided to be more careful about that from now on!
choice_data_list: Palmer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I guess you already saw right through me, though, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I was really trying to act natural and stuff, but your sixth sense is, like, no joke!
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about me.
You don't need to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Supporting you is what I live for.
Supporting you is what I live for.
Let's just carry on as we always have.
Let's just carry on as we always have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Supporting you is what I live for.
Supporting you is what I live for.
Let's just carry on as we always have.
Let's just carry on as we always have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh… Yeah, I gotcha. I mean, even when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold the phone. What did you say just now?
choice_data_list: What, "Supporting you is what I live for"?
What, "Supporting you is what I live for"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that! Do you realize what you just said?
choice_data_list: Realize… what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Man, you're so oblivious sometimes! Not that that's a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm gonna head back now! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch Mejiro Palmer jog back to her dorm, I can only hope she understood what I was trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Yeah, we were both acting mad sus today, weren't we?
choice_data_list: I think we should just be ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm there with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No more walking on eggshells! You be you and I'll be me. Now lemme hear you say, "Waheeey!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the Mejiro Palmer I know is back. What a relief.
